entities.summary: Bishop Ábel Antal Szocska, O.S.B.M. is a Hungarian Greek Catholic hierarch. He is serving as the first Eparchial Bishop of the Hungarian Catholic Eparchy of Nyíregyháza from 31 October 2015.
